description: Swipe the screen for real (CoreDevice or idb on the iOS Simulator, adb on Android): scroll a list, dismiss a sheet, change a page. Give a direction (the way your finger moves) or from/to points as fractions of the screen. To reach the bottom of a list, pass untilEnd: true. It swipes again until the screen stops moving, in one call.

allowBuoy.description: Swipe even if Buoy's own panel covers the starting point.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

direction.description: "up" scrolls content down the list (finger moves up).

drag.description: Drag instead of flick: press, hold, then move (reorder handles, drag and drop, sliders). On the iOS Simulator with older Xcode (idb) it is a slow swipe only.

serial.description: Android: the adb serial, when several devices are connected.

untilEnd.description: Keep swiping until the screen stops moving (the end of the list), up to 15 swipes. Returns the last screen.

name: native_swipe
